## 👋 Introduction

Thank you for considering contributing to HK2 Magento PHP 8.1 FPM! We welcome contributions from the community to help improve this project.

---

## 🐛 Reporting Bugs

If you find a bug, please help us by reporting it using the provided bug report template.
- Ensure the bug was not already reported by searching on GitHub under Issues.
- If you're unable to find an open issue addressing the problem, open a new one.
- Be sure to include a title and clear description, as much relevant information as possible, and a code sample or an executable test case demonstrating the expected behavior that is not occurring.

---

## 💡 Suggesting Enhancements

If you have an idea for a new feature or an improvement to an existing feature, we'd love to hear it!
- Open a new issue with a clear title and description.
- Explain why the enhancement would be useful and how it should work.

---

## 🛠️ Pull Requests

1. Fork the repository and create your branch from `main`.
2. If you've added code that should be tested, add tests.
3. Ensure the test suite passes.
4. Make sure your code passes the linting/code style checks.
5. Issue a pull request providing a clear description of the changes.

---

## 🧑‍💻 Coding Standards

Please adhere to standard Magento 2 coding standards (e.g., PHPCS, MEQP) when contributing PHP code. For Docker configurations, follow best practices for writing clean and maintainable Dockerfiles.
